notes: unlimited=true is Pribin's 'all 31 agents at once' mode (no parallel cap, no pacing, no budget brake; only the memory brake min_free_gb). Bounded knobs the COO may change: max_parallel 1-31, run_token_budget 30000-120000, max_turns 10-30, standing_budget_fraction 0.1-0.6, task_wall_seconds 600-3600, standing_per_hour 0-8 (0 = off), min_free_gb 0.3-3.0. The COO must not lower max_parallel or turn pacing back on while unlimited is true.
